channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has "total control" over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President Trump said Wednesday that the U.S. has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz, writing on social media: "I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT."

item.title: Iran live updates: Araghchi says US 'miscalculated' due to intel 'failures'
item.description: President Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy breaks down in court, says 'I can't do it' during trial
item.description: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy was halted several times Wednesday as she sobbed and expressed distress during testimony.

item.title: Ex-Republican David Jolly aims to flip Florida for Democrats
item.description: David Jolly, a former Republican running as a Democrat for Florida governor, seeks to make the state competitive again.
